author: Kek28
quote: Genuinely a boring game to play. Story is awful, driving is abysmal and is somehow worse than cyberpunks driving, way too realistic to the point I have to fill up my gas tank, character writing also abysmal with no humor whatsoever, morality system is a GTA game was definitely a choice but not a smart one, can’t steal certain cars until a certain point in the game, and the list goes on. Do not buy this game full price it is a scam. Wait for a sale at best. The only good thing this game has at the moment is the graphics but even that’s not impressive cause what game in 2026 doesn’t have good graphics. Severely disappointing in a franchise I once loved.
